data_fields.name: unload_step_budget
data_fields.donor_constant: max_move, supplied by caller (min(transfer count, max_move))

best_idea: Plan the whole move first as per-designation counts, then commit it in capped steps that merge only identical-provenance stacks under a hard cap.
decision_why: Keep the plan-then-commit shape, per-step budget and stack cap; drop next-hop routing and the money feeder share, since Frankendom has no next station and one ledger.
acceptance: A server test moves 300 stackable items into a bag with stack cap 255 and gets stacks of 255 and 45 in order; a server-rejected move leaves source and destination unchanged.
